name: Fisheye Sphere Text
bestFor: Hook titles on a fisheye sphere that snap-rolls line by line, or a glass fisheye lens gliding over a paragraph.
reference: Inspired by "Day 57 of teaching After Effects Basics" (fisheye / CC Sphere text)

name: Paper Cut-out Text
bestFor: Playful handmade content: bubble-letter words on torn paper that flutter down, tear and seal, or stamp in at 12 fps stop motion.
reference: Inspired by "How to create paper text effects — regular text is boring"

name: Depth & Orbit Text
bestFor: Moody talking heads: words peek out from behind the subject, climb a helix around them, giant letters rise behind them, words fly through a depth tunnel.
reference: Inspired by "How to do the 3D text effect… straight sauce ep 1"

name: Word-Pop Captions
bestFor: Fast explainers and AI/tool workflows: rolling one-word captions, marker underlines, cursor select, circle-reveal chapter cards, letters dropping behind the subject.
reference: Inspired by "My workflow for using AI in my videos — comment 'Magic'"

name: Spiral Orbit Text
bestFor: Hook lines that wrap around the speaker: a sentence slides along a 3D spiral round the head (far side behind them), keeps turning, then the camera dives through it.
reference: Inspired by the word-spiral in "How to do the 3D text effect… straight sauce ep 1"

name: Halo Orbit Text
bestFor: A one-line hook circling the speaker's head like a tilted halo: pops in, orbits (back half behind the subject), flies out past the camera.
reference: Style 03's original orbit scene, kept as its own effect

name: Cube Roll Words
bestFor: Lower-third keywords and lists: four words on the faces of a solid 3D bar that tumbles in and rolls one face per beat.

name: Blinds Unfold Text
bestFor: Bold one-word statements and title sequences: each word is cut into horizontal slats that swing open like venetian blinds.

name: Domino Letters
bestFor: Product names and one-word reveals with a physical, toy-like feel: thick 3D letters stand up like dominoes and knock each other over.

name: Split-Flap Board
bestFor: Announcements, dates, prices, destinations: text that clatters into place on an airport departure board.

name: Extruded Title Orbit
bestFor: Hero titles and intros: a thick 3D block-letter headline the camera orbits around before it snaps face-on.

name: Page Flip Words
bestFor: Storytelling and list intros with a tactile, editorial feel: one word per page of an open book, pages turning on the spine.

name: Flag Wave Letters
bestFor: Energetic two-word hooks over talking heads: the letters ripple like a flag in the wind, then a gust blows them away.

name: Echo Stack Text
bestFor: Big brand words and launches: a word with a deep trail of outline echoes that collapse into one solid word.

name: Cube Unfold Text
bestFor: Six-part messages as one object: a cube with a word on every face spins, then unfolds flat into a cross so all six read at once.

name: Horizon Crawl
bestFor: Big intros, manifestos and 'here's what's coming' lists: lines glide away across a neon grid floor, then the key word stands up out of it.

name: Infinite Spiral Text
bestFor: Hypnotic background behind a talking head: a phrase streams endlessly out of a self-similar spiral that fills the frame.

name: Wall Perspective Text
bestFor: Corridor and room footage: words painted on the side walls, following their perspective; they arrive, paint on, drift closer (never cropped) and recede.

name: Bend Text 3D
bestFor: Physical, playful titles: a headline on a flexible sheet that bows, curves, rolls into a spinning tube and springs flat.

name: Horizontal Orbit Text
bestFor: A slogan orbiting the speaker like a carousel ring: evenly spaced upright letters on a horizontal circle, the back half passing behind them, mirrored.

name: 3D Pop Letters
bestFor: Punchy one-word titles: a flat word pops up letter by letter into candy-coloured 3D blocks with shockwaves, sways, spin-waves and sinks flat.
reference: Inspired by "3D Text Pop Up Animation Tutorial in After Effects"

name: Tag Pile Drop
bestFor: Lists of benefits or keywords: pill tags and star badges drop onto a table one by one into a readable heap, then fly back up.
reference: Inspired by "Stacking Animation Tutorial in After Effects"

name: Paper Roll Unfold
bestFor: Lists and punchlines: the words themselves roll up like a paper roll (no paper, only type) and unroll from top to bottom.

name: Snake Text
bestFor: One punchy sentence that slithers diagonally across the screen in the shape of a snake, the last word as its head.

name: Contour Rings Text
bestFor: Quotes and intros over a talking head: lines of text nest round the speaker's head like contour lines, growing ring by ring.
reference: Inspired by a typography motion-graphics tutorial (words wrapped round a head)

name: Camera Lockup Type
bestFor: Hooks and titles: words flip in one by one into a tight justified block of mixed sizes while the camera frames each word.
reference: Inspired by a typography motion-graphics tutorial (stacked lockup)

name: Turning Camera Type
bestFor: Hooks and statements: words lock into a flush typographic puzzle, some on their side, while the camera turns 90° to read each one.
reference: Inspired by a typography motion-graphics tutorial (rotating word puzzle)
